title: Yakuza Kiwami
subtitle: Kamurocho, December 2005
credits: Locker key and MesuKing card locations compiled from community guides (GameFAQs, TheGamer, RPG Site, Neoseeker, Gamers Heroes, GameSkinny, Sportskeeda). Yakuza Kiwami is a trademark of SEGA; this is an unofficial fan map.
notes: Locker keys show up as small glints on the ground. Pick one up and take it to the coin lockers on Taihei Blvd. (in front of the theater, west of Millennium Tower) to open the matching locker.

MesuKing cards lying around town look like a glowing red butterfly, and a few are tucked into gaps you only see in first-person view (R3). Cards you buy, get from the Professor or win in substories are shown at the shop or place that gives them.

Marker positions are placed on a schematic map from written guide descriptions, so treat them as "roughly here" and read the description for the exact spot. Use Edit mode to nudge a marker and export the corrected data.
